title: Vegan Budget Meals: Tofu Ricotta Lasagna, Oat Milk, Chickpea Scramble & More
summary: This Goodful video demonstrates a suite of budget-conscious vegan recipes and techniques, anchored by inexpensive pantry staples and simple home processes. The host crafts a tofu-based ricotta for a lasagna, builds a mushroom–eggplant meat sauce, and bakes the dish in the oven without conventional dairy cheeses. It then moves through a series of money-saving staples and methods: homemade oat milk, a roasted-garlic–pepper sauce for a mac and cheese-inspired dish, baked banana oatmeal, chickpea scramble, zucchini-red lentil fritters with a tofu sour cream, a cast-iron vegan bacon build, and a hearty chili made from dried beans and TVP. Across sections, the video highlights cost-cutting strategies such as using dried beans, bulk grains, and produce from farmers markets, while emphasizing flavor-building ingredients like nutritional yeast, smoked paprika, and aromatics. The overall message is practical, hands-on vegan cooking that reduces expense without sacrificing taste or texture.

sections.title: Tofu Ricotta Preparation
sections.description: Create an inexpensive dairy-free ricotta by blending extra-firm tofu with lemon juice, nutritional yeast for cheesy flavor, garlic, dried basil, and seasonings.

sections.title: Mushroom–Eggplant Meat Sauce
sections.description: Sauté aromatics and cheap veggies (mushrooms and eggplant) to build a meaty texture; flavor with soy sauce and Italian seasoning before adding tomato sauce and simmering.

sections.title: Lasagna Assembly and Baking Prep
sections.description: Layer bottom sauce, pasta noodles, ricotta, and meat sauce; finish with more sauce and basil; cover with foil and bake (25 minutes at 375F, then 5 more uncovered).

sections.title: Lasagna Finishing Remarks
sections.description: Assessment and confirmation that the dish looks and tastes satisfying; notes on serving size and veggie texture (eggplant and mushroom).

sections.title: Homemade Oat Milk
sections.description: Blend oats with water, then strain through a fine cloth to produce a simple, inexpensive plant milk.

sections.title: Garlic-Forward Cheese Sauce for Mac and Cheese
sections.description: Develop a root-to-tip cheese sauce using roasted garlic, shallots, and a pepper-tinged base; thicken with cornstarch and blend with oat milk and broth for a cheesy vegan sauce.

sections.title: Coating Elbow Mac with Cheesy Sauce
sections.description: Cook pasta and coat with the prepared vegan cheese sauce; notes on choosing budget pasta for a boxed-like mac and cheese experience.

sections.title: Baked Banana Oatmeal
sections.description: Banana-based oatmeal bake with oats and spices; baked in loaf pans and finished with a drizzle of homemade sunflower seed butter.

sections.title: Chickpea Scramble
sections.description: A protein-rich scramble using chickpea flour and aquafaba, seasoned with turmeric and spices, then cooked with aromatics.

sections.title: Zucchini and Red Lentil Fritters
sections.description: Grate zucchini, remove moisture, mix with red lentils and pantry staples to form patties; fry until crisp for a cheap, filling dish.

sections.title: Vegan Bacon and BLT Build
sections.description: Crisp vegan bacon in a cast-iron skillet, served on bread with vegan mayo and garden tomatoes to form a bacon-tinged BLT.

sections.title: Hearty Vegan Chili with Dried Beans and TVP
sections.description: Chili built from dried beans (soaked/coooked), fire-roasted tomatoes, corn, and vegetable broth; spiced with chili powder, cumin, paprika, and cayenne; finished with TVP in place of meat for budget-friendly protein; topped with tofu sour cream and discussed as a cost-saving example.

sections.title: Budget Cooking Philosophy and Wrap
sections.description: Closing remarks reinforcing that vegan cooking can be affordable and flavorful when using cost-conscious ingredients and smart shopping strategies.
